_comment: The Paddle Down food menu, transcribed from the Paddle Down Menu PDF. Prices are plain numbers on the printed menu (no $), kept that way here so the page matches it. `featured` marks the signature platter. Optional `notice` renders a banner in the hero — delete the field once the full menu is live and the banner disappears. Diet codes: veg = V, gf = GF, gfa = GFA (gluten-free available).

notes: Court menu for guests 12 and under — ask your server.
Ask your server about the bar list: courtside cocktails, wine, draft beer and zero-proof.
Consuming raw or under-cooked meats, poultry, seafood, shellfish or eggs may increase your risk of food-borne illness.
Before placing your order, please inform your server if a person in your party has a food allergy.
